description: packed dirt road through short green meadow grass, even medium green, seen from above
_note: Tried and NOT shipped: the PixelLab Tiles Pro route (tile_feature 'roads', 18 sub-tiles of 32 px on an edge rule), which tools/roadtile.py consumes with --pro, stamping a 3x3 of sub-tiles per 96 px piece. The --sweep route over t32_dirt_203.json won because it gives true circular curves and 45 degree diagonals rather than a 32 px staircase.
